A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the NO system is present in all cell types of the myenteric plexus and that the NO produced is used to modulate the physiology of all these cells.
the NO system is a very complex system, which is not restricted to the endothelial cells and the nervous system.
the RBCs have the machinery for the synthesis of NO, which they may use to regulate their own physiology.
The main takeaway from our work is that
RBCs are not just passive carriers of oxygen, but are active cells that synthesize and use a variety of molecules, including NO.
the RBCs may be more active than previously assumed, and they may be able to synthesize and use their own nitric-oxide.
RBCs are not passive cells that only respond to the signals from other cells.
